answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 240 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is recorded in the tundra receipt and checked against the ridge nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the nebula audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
